analysis_notes.summary: This is a short, practical sicha-style teaching about prayer kavvanot. It does not employ the standard bechina rhetorical structure where concepts are equated as parallel aspects. Instead, it uses a linear advisory structure: do not use kavvanot unless worthy → the essence of prayer is simple meaning → devekut is the goal → true tzaddikim naturally include all kavvanot in their simple reading. None of the concepts are connected through bechina declarations, so they cannot form packages under the bechina-only rule. The comparison of unworthy kavvanot to kishuf is a rhetorical analogy (using the drasha of 'lo tilmad la'asot'), not a bechina identity statement.
